command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS round 1, N4 diagnostic (competence vs combination)

metrics.arms: a: single-task PartsFlow r32 on 50 generated N4 carries (seeds 0-2); P: pp_full_r32_s10-12; controls: single-task fits on generated K4 / K1; o: oracle planner.  Familiar layout, dev states 4-23
metrics.flag: a control's single-task fit beating P on its own task by > 0.10 with lower bound > 0 (reported, no verdict change)
metrics.mapping: D = s_a(N4) - s_P(N4): competence iff D <= 0.10; combination iff D > 0.10 and CI lower bound > 0 (failing phase = largest P deficit among hold, arrival, place-on-arrival); else unresolved
metrics.status: PRE-REGISTERED PLAN_PARTS round 1 N4 diagnostic (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 10)
metrics.written_before: the oracle runs, any rollout of this round and its read
